```yaml
name: Promote RC to Stable

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      rc_tag:
        description: 'RC tag to promote (e.g., v3.0.0-rc5)'
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: write
  packages: write

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      rc_tag: ${{ steps.set_rc.outputs.rc_tag }}
      stable_tag: ${{ steps.compute_stable.outputs.stable_tag }}
      commit_sha: ${{ steps.get_sha.outputs.commit_sha }}
    env:
      RC_TAG: ${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set RC tag
        id: set_rc
        run: echo "rc_tag=$RC_TAG" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Compute stable tag
        id: compute_stable
        run: |
          echo "STABLE_TAG=${RC_TAG/-rc[0-9]*/}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "stable_tag=${RC_TAG/-rc[0-9]*/}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Get commit SHA of RC tag
        id: get_sha
        run: |
          echo "commit_sha=$(git rev-parse "$RC_TAG")" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Validate RC tag exists
        run: |
          if ! git rev-parse --verify "$RC_TAG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "RC tag $RC_TAG does not exist."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Validate stable tag does not exist
        run: |
          if git rev-parse --verify "$STABLE_TAG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "Stable tag $STABLE_TAG already exists."
            exit 1
          fi

  promote:
    needs: validate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      RC_TAG: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.rc_tag }}
      STABLE_TAG: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}
      COMMIT_SHA: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.commit_sha }}
      IMAGE_NAMES: "grafana/beyla grafana/beyla-k8s-cache"
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Create stable git tag
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git tag -a "$STABLE_TAG" -m "Promote $RC_TAG to stable" "$COMMIT_SHA"
          git push origin "$STABLE_TAG"

      - name: Retag Docker images
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          docker login ghcr.io -u ${{ github.actor }} -p "$GITHUB_TOKEN"
          for image in $IMAGE_NAMES; do
            docker buildx imagetools create ghcr.io/$image:$RC_TAG --tag ghcr.io/$image:$STABLE_TAG
          done

      - name: Create stable GitHub release
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          gh release create "$STABLE_TAG" --generate-notes --title "$STABLE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"

      - name: Copy assets from RC release to stable release
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          rc_assets=$(gh release view "$RC_TAG" --json assets --jq '.assets[] | .url')
          while read -r asset_url; do
            asset_name=$(basename "${asset_url%%\?*}")
            curl -L -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" -H "Accept: application/octet-stream" -o "$asset_name" "$asset_url"
            gh release upload "$STABLE_TAG" "$asset_name"
          done <<< "$rc_assets"

      - name: Add promotion checklist to summary
        run: |
          echo "## Promotion Checklist" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- Helm chart updated and published" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- Technical documentation updated" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
```
